AI_AGENT_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Magpie AI reads each new customer message and writes a draft reply in the Magpie side panel. A teammate checks it and sends it.
AI_AGENT_SETTINGS.UNAVAILABLE: Magpie AI isn't set up on this installation yet.

TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: Write a draft for every new customer message in the inboxes below.

MODE.DRAFT_DESCRIPTION: Magpie writes the reply, a teammate sends it.
MODE.AUTO_DESCRIPTION: Magpie sends replies that pass its fact check. Refunds, flagged messages and handoffs still go to your team.
MODE.PAUSED: Auto is paused for every team right now. Magpie writes drafts until it's back.

KNOWLEDGE.DESCRIPTION: Magpie answers from your published help center articles, plus the websites and files you add here.
KNOWLEDGE.WEBSITES_DESCRIPTION: Up to 50 pages each, read again every day.
KNOWLEDGE.FILES_DESCRIPTION: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, Markdown or text, up to 20 MB.

USAGE.CAP_REACHED: Magpie reached this month's limit and stopped answering.

TESTS.DESCRIPTION: Magpie answers up to 30 past conversations again and is checked against what your team sent.
TESTS.QUESTION: Customer

TRACES.DESCRIPTION: Every turn Magpie took, step by step: what it read, what it called, what it decided and what it cost.

APPS.DESCRIPTION: Connect your team's apps so Magpie can look things up. Magpie only reads, and only the signed-in customer's own records.

DETAILS.stripe: Charges and duplicate payments for the signed-in customer.
DETAILS.linear: Whether a reported bug is known or fixed.
